data.gender_notes: Bahiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'b-h-y', meaning 'to shine, to be radiant'. In Islamic context, it represents a person who shines with inner and outer beauty, wisdom, and grace. The name Bahiyyah carries the meaning “Radiant, shining one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahiyyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
